summary: Preserve provider-visible same-run cache prefix continuity by deferring opportunistic Tool Working Set receipt folding after round 1 while retaining the hard result-count safety valve, historical offline/boundary behavior, and explicit telemetry for canary verification.

components.owning_subsystem: provider-visible history projection and Tool Working Set cache-prefix preservation
components.disposition: ADMIT as narrow mechanical cache-lineage control. The program only decides whether opportunistic soft/coarse receipt folding may rewrite already-sent same-run history; model semantic relevance, task strategy, evidence selection, and completion remain model-owned. hard_result_cap remains mandatory.
evidence: Live attribution reproduced same-run prompt shrink when soft/coarse receipt folding replaced prior provider-visible tool results in place; one natural event shrank provider-visible chars from 94,295 to 72,458 and cache hit ratio to about 60.25%, followed by about 93.74% recovery on the next request.
Deterministic projection tests prove logical_round > 1 suppresses opportunistic soft/coarse folding while hard_result_cap still folds when required.
Engine-level selective-evidence coverage proves round-2 projection preserves selected evidence authority and does not opportunistically rewrite unselected raw tool results.
Telemetry exposes opportunistic_fold_allowed under ingress.tool_working_set for production canary verification.
components.verification_level: Committed-state focused/adjacent pytest 101/101, Ruff, Pyright 0/0 on changed production paths, py_compile, diff-check, and full ci_gate
components.model_evidence_veto_recovery_exit: The change is mechanical and observable. Operators can inspect request.meta tool_working_set telemetry and cache_health lineage; hard_result_cap still provides bounded safety, and the single implementation commit can be reverted without data migration.
components.rollback_route: Revert cache-prefix implementation commit(s) on this review branch and redeploy the prior exact main 19e253ed rollback anchor; no persistent data conversion is involved.

g1.necessity: Within an active multi-round run, opportunistic Tool Working Set soft/coarse folding could rewrite provider-visible history that had already participated in the cache prefix. This caused discrete prompt-shrink warmups and materially reduced cache reuse despite otherwise healthy comparable-lineage cache behavior.
